True def transform(grid):
    rows = [row[:] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i == 0 or row != grid[i - 1]]
    keep = [j for j in range(len(rows[0])) if j == 0 or any(row[j] != row[j - 1] for row in rows)]
    return [[row[j] for j in keep] for row in rows]
